sn17.35:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate. acirapakkante devadatte
sn17.35:1.2: tatra kho bhagavā devadattaṃ ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi
sn17.35:1.3: attavadhāya bhikkhave devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi parābhavāya devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi.
sn17.35:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kadalī attavadhāya phalaṃ deti parā bhavāya phalaṃ deti.
sn17.35:2.2: evameva kho bhikkhave attavadhāya devadattassa lābhasakkāra siloko udapādi parābhavāya devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi.
sn17.35:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave veḷu attavadhāya phalaṃ deti parā bhavāya phalaṃ deti.
sn17.35:3.2: evameva kho bhikkhave attavadhāya devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi parābhavāya devadattassa lābhasakkāra siloko udapādi.
sn17.35:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave naḷo attavadhāya phalaṃ deti parā bhavāya phalaṃ deti.
sn17.35:4.2: evameva kho bhikkhave attavadhāya devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi parābhavāya devadattassa lābhasakkāra- siloko udapādi.
sn17.35:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave assatarī attavadhāya gabbhaṃ gaṇhāti parābhavāya gabbhaṃ gaṇhāti.
sn17.35:5.2: evameva kho bhikkhave attavadhāya devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi parābhavāya devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi.
sn17.35:5.3: evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābha sakkārasiloko udapādi …
sn17.35:6.2: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
